entries.en:
In Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre, you come upon Jihli Aliapoh, who regales you with the history of the event known as Hatching-tide─a festival born of her vision of the Twelve Archons of the Sixth Umbral Era. As she tells it, this year she was blessed with another vision: this one not of storied heroes, but of fluffy rabbits─which may in part explain her curious appearance. Though what she has in mind is not immediately clear, one thing is: she requires your aid to make the festival a success. Should you be inclined to lend your assistance, seek out her colleague Nonotta by the Carline Canopy and see what you might do on the celebrants' behalf.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.

Abonnée aux songes surréalistes, Jihli Aliapoh a cette fois rêvé de lapins débarquant en Éorzéa pour faire le bonheur des enfants, ce qui l'a poussée à promouvoir sa fameuse chasse aux Prœufs vêtue d'un costume de léporidé du plus bon goût. Dans votre grande bonté, vous avez accepté de l'aider à concrétiser sa singulière vision. Pour savoir exactement quelle tâche vous incombe, commencez par retrouver son amie Nonotta près des Feuilles de carline.

entries.en: You find Nonotta, herself curiously dressed as an oversized hare, who is all too eager to share with you her plight. To wit, a veritable legion of chickens painstakingly procured by her and Jihli have flown the coop, placing their meticulous plans for this year's festivities in peril. Put your hen-hunting skills to the test and go forth to recover these exceptional egg-laying specimens, that the celebration might not meet a premature demise.
entries.fr: Nonotta, l'amie de Jihli elle aussi déguisée en lapine, a malencontreusement laissé s'échapper les poules pondeuses dont elle avait la charge. Elle compte sur vous pour rattraper les évadées, et sa bévue par la même occasion. Rendez-vous dans la Forêt centrale et parlez à l'un des organisateurs de la chasse aux Prœufs pour obtenir un costume de , puis accomplissez l'ALÉA “Poules parties”.

entries.en: Back at the amphitheatre, Jihli rejoices upon hearing that the chickens have been returned, allowing Hatching-tide to begin in earnest. After Nonotta takes her leave, Jihli informs you in secret that she believes you to be the key to the success of this year's festivities. If you feel so inclined, wait around and offer your aid when the time is right.

entries.en: Allow me to explain. In the hopes of turning this year's Hatching-tide into a true event for the ages, we scoured the realm and procured a host of chickens that would lay for us the most remarkable eggs.

entries.en: Needless to say, without our hens, there can be no eggs. And without our eggs, there can be no Hatching-tide! Surely you can see our plight? And so I beg of you, my friend: please go out there and catch our precious birds before they are swallowed up by the beasts that prowl the wood.
